question: A’s speed is 30% more than that of B. If A and B run a race on a 117 m length race, what part of the length of the race should A give B as a head start, so that the race ends in a dead heat?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of race is 117m

Speed of A is 30% more than speed of B

**Concept Used:**

To end the race in a dead heat, both players should reach the finish point at the same time.

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance/Speed
